newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-KORZENIOWSKI ADDS WORLD GOLD TO OLYMPIC TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KORZENIOWSKI ADDS WORLD GOLD TO OLYMPIC TITLE.

text.p: Poland's Robert Korzeniowski added the world gold to his Olympic title on Thursday when he took the 50 kilometres walk in three hours 44 minutes and 46 seconds.
Korzeniowski walked an almost flawless race, picking up only one warning, and took the lead with just over four kilometres to go.
He had duelled for much of the race with Spain's Jesus Garcia, the 1997 World Cup winner, but managed to match Garcia's repeated attempts to pull away.
Garcia stayed in close contact to finished second in 3:44.59. Mexico's Miguel Rodriguez took the bronze medal.
